findings.summary: Orphaned dead code file not deleted
findings.detail: The `validateCardIconImageConflict` function was replaced by the declarative `mutuallyExclusiveWith` approach on card.types.ts. The import was removed but the file itself was not deleted. It is no longer referenced anywhere.
findings.correction: Delete `src/definitions/tags/block/card/diagnostics/imageAttrConflict.ts` and remove the `diagnostics/` folder if empty.

findings.summary: Duplicate detection regex can false-positive on quoted attribute values
findings.detail: The regex `/\b([\w-]+)\s*(?=\s*=)/gi` operates on raw tag text without skipping quoted strings. A tag like `{% code lang=csharp title="lang=test" %}` would match `lang` twice (real attr + inside value), producing a false duplicate warning. Low probability in practice but a correctness gap.
findings.correction: Strip or skip quoted values from `afterTagName` before running the regex, e.g. `afterTagName.replace(/"[^"]*"|'[^']*'/g, '')` before matching.
